Testimonies from past conferences

Every gathering leaves stories behind. Here are some of them, shared by women who were there.

Divine Healing

“I want to bless the name of God for my health. In march I was diagnosed with hyperprolatinomia, I was scared and didn’t know what to do. It was initially 186 instead of 25. I took drugs and it increased to 196 after 3 months. At some point the doctor asked me to do a brain MRI to be sure there is no tumor in my brain I met with mama and she spent time teaching me on faith, prayed for me, and asked me to run the test again. I ran the MRI and found nothing, my brain was perfectly normal and then I did another test and my prolactin level became normal with a number of 20mg. Glory to God!”

Favour O.

The Overflow, 2025

Sight and abundance

"I received the empowerment for ministry, the weight and consciousness of my assignment came on me during the conference. I'm better equipped and empowered to do ministry than I ever was. Secondly , I received clear instructions from God, clear visions of the near future, and I have walked into the overflow!"

Oge U.

The Overflow, 2025

Light and The She Blossoms Foodbank

"...Let’s talk about the She Blossoms Foodbank... That one alone? Life-saving! At a time when I was literally thinking of how to survive the week, God showed up through this community. “He prepares a table before me…” (Psalm 23:5) and yes, He truly did. Not just physically, but spiritually too.” Then came Pastor Ada, the set woman with fire in her words. Her teaching on overflowing rivers hit me deep. She said, “A well symbolizes sustenance. without water, there’s no inhabitation.” She reminded us that we are not called in the realm of time, but of light. That one line changed how I now view my life and purpose.

ThankGod N.

The Overflow, 2025

Relationship by design

The relationship panel? I won’t forget it. I learned to set boundaries, honour myself, and focus on my assignment. Marriage isn’t about pressure or people’s opinions, it’s about the right reason, the right person, and the right season. That truth set me free.

ThankGod N.

The Overflow, 2025
